title: The Forbidden Book Chose Me
summary: A forbidden grimoire offers an expelled student one final entrance exam: uncover who erased his magic before the academy erases him.
summary_zh: 被除名的学生与禁书缔约，必须在学院抹去他的存在前，查出是谁夺走了他的魔法。
character_brief: Kael, 21, male, tousled black hair, violet eyes, torn navy academy coat with silver embroidery
cover_scene: A floating black grimoire at locked gothic academy gates in violet evening mist

title: Class Zero
summary: Assigned to a class for unranked adults, a failed prodigy discovers that each classmate can break a different rule of magic—and someone has scheduled their disappearance.
summary_zh: 被分进无法评级的零号班后，你发现同学各自能打破一条魔法法则，而全班已被列入清除名单。
character_brief: Rin, 22, female, cropped white hair, amber eyes, black uniform with a scarlet armband
cover_scene: An empty lecture hall, shattered ranking crystals floating above one open palm

title: My Rival Knows My Future
title_zh: 我的对手知道我的未来
summary: Your academy rival keeps saving you from disasters that have not happened. To stop a foretold duel, you must learn which future she is trying to protect.
summary_zh: 学院宿敌总能阻止尚未发生的灾难。决斗临近，你必须弄清她到底想保护哪一个未来。
character_brief: Elise, 23, female, long chestnut braid, blue eyes, white fencing jacket over navy uniform
cover_scene: A rain-wet academy bridge, a cracked pocket watch in her hand, clocktower behind

title: The Last Seat at Eclipse Academy
title_zh: 蚀月学院的最后一个名额
summary: A late admission letter arrives during an eclipse. Your scholarship belongs to a student who never existed, and every teacher remembers a different version of you.
summary_zh: 月食时收到的录取信属于一个不存在的人，而每位老师都记得不同版本的你。
character_brief: Noa, 21, androgynous adult, dark plum hair, pale gold eyes, tailored indigo cloak
cover_scene: A crescent-lit observatory entrance, blank admission envelope and a suspended eclipse

title: The Saintess Failed Her Exam
summary: The kingdom's chosen saintess cannot pass basic spellcraft. As her reluctant tutor, you discover her miracles obey a language the academy forbids anyone to teach.
summary_zh: 被神谕选中的圣女不会基础魔法。成为她的导师后，你发现奇迹使用的是学院禁止传授的语言。
character_brief: Mira, 22, female, strawberry-blonde curls, green eyes, modest ivory ceremonial uniform
cover_scene: A sunlit practice room, a failed spell crystal and one small impossible flower

title: A Scholarship from the Demon King
summary: An anonymous patron pays your tuition in exchange for monthly reports. The patron is the demon king, and your first assignment is to keep the future hero alive.
summary_zh: 匿名资助者支付学费，条件是定期汇报。对方竟是魔王，而你的任务是保护未来的勇者。
character_brief: Vesper, 25, male, silver hair, red eyes, burgundy formal coat and subtle horn-shaped brooch
cover_scene: A candlelit study, sealed scholarship envelope and distant academy spires

title: The Academy Beneath the Lake
summary: When the lake freezes, a staircase appears beneath the ice. The submerged academy offers you a place—provided you return a memory each time you surface.
summary_zh: 湖面结冰时，冰下出现通往学院的阶梯；每一次返回地面，都要交出一段记忆。
character_brief: Iona, 24, female, long sea-green hair, gray eyes, pearl-trimmed winter academy coat
cover_scene: Underwater gothic windows viewed beneath translucent ice, a luminous pearl in hand

title: My Familiar Is the Final Boss
summary: Your summoning exam produces a tiny creature with the seal of the world's destroyer. Raising it might prevent the prophecy—or teach it exactly how to fulfill it.
summary_zh: 召唤考试带来一只印着灭世纹章的小兽。养大它，也许能改变预言，也可能成全预言。
character_brief: Theo, 21, male, sandy brown hair, hazel eyes, moss-green apprentice coat
cover_scene: A little black winged fox perched on his shoulder, faint enormous beast silhouette in magical smoke

title: Everyone Forgot the Top Student
title_zh: 所有人都忘了年级第一
summary: A portrait in the honors hall changes every night. You alone remember its original subject, and your investigation makes your own name begin to vanish.
summary_zh: 荣誉墙上的肖像每夜变化。只有你记得原本的第一名，而你的名字也开始从记录中消失。
character_brief: Sera, 23, female, long black hair, violet-gray eyes, silver-rim glasses, dark uniform
cover_scene: An empty ornate portrait frame, a single silver student medal, dim archival corridor

title: The Hero Course Reject
summary: Rejected from the hero program, you join the cleanup unit. Every ruined battlefield reveals a lie about the celebrated victories—and the next rescue may make you a traitor.
summary_zh: 进入英雄科失败后，你负责战后善后。废墟揭露了胜利背后的谎言，而下一次救援可能让你成为叛徒。
character_brief: Jace, 24, male, dark brown undercut, amber eyes, orange utility jacket, rescue harness
cover_scene: A damaged training arena, rescue lantern held high, distant abandoned hero cape

title: The Girl Who Steals Tomorrow
summary: She can borrow one day from the future, but someone else must lose it. When she saves your life, you inherit the debt collectors who stand outside time.
summary_zh: 她能借用未来的一天，代价由别人支付。她救下你后，时间之外的追债者找上了门。
character_brief: Lune, 22, female, short lavender hair, cyan eyes, midnight cape with clock-shaped clasp
cover_scene: A stopped campus clock, a glass hourglass holding a small sunrise

title: Our Club Ends the World
title_zh: 我们的社团会毁灭世界
summary: The university's smallest club studies harmless urban legends. Each solved mystery brings the same impossible date closer: the day your club photo ends the world.
summary_zh: 大学冷门社团调查都市传说，每解开一个谜题，那张会毁灭世界的合照就更接近成形。
character_brief: Ada, 22, female, curly brown hair, hazel eyes, mustard cardigan, camera strap
cover_scene: A cluttered clubroom at dusk, one instant camera, a dark red comet outside

title: The Villain Teaches Ethics
summary: A retired villain becomes your professor. His final assignment asks you to defend a person the kingdom has already condemned—and the evidence points to your classmates.
summary_zh: 退役反派开设伦理课，期末任务是为王国判定的罪人辩护，而线索指向你的同学。
character_brief: Professor Vale, 34, male, swept-back dark hair, silver streak, gray eyes, black academic coat
cover_scene: A marble lecture room, balanced brass scales and a fractured white mask on the lectern

title: A Duel Before Graduation
title_zh: 毕业之前，最后一场决斗
summary: Two former partners must duel for the only royal appointment. On the eve of graduation, one asks you to investigate why the academy needs the loser to disappear.
summary_zh: 曾经的搭档争夺唯一王室任命。毕业决斗前夜，对方请求你调查为何败者必须消失。
character_brief: Celia, 24, female, copper ponytail, gray-blue eyes, white and crimson dueling uniform
cover_scene: A rooftop practice arena at sunset, one lowered rapier and drifting graduation ribbons

title: Please Hide My Halo
summary: An angel enrolls in a human ability academy to investigate a missing prayer. Her halo keeps revealing her secrets, and the quiet student beside her can see every one.
summary_zh: 天使潜入人类异能学院寻找失踪的祈愿，可藏不住的光环总在暴露秘密。
character_brief: Ariel, 23, female, golden bob, warm brown eyes, oversized blue academy blazer
cover_scene: A luminous halo partly obscured by a blue umbrella, sunlit campus courtyard

title: The Hero Left Me His Debt
summary: The hero dies with your name on his will. You inherit no sword or kingdom, only a debt ledger—and creditors who claim his final quest was never finished.
summary_zh: 勇者遗嘱只留下一本债簿。债主来自各个种族，而最后一笔欠款是一场未完成的远征。
character_brief: Rowan, 27, male, auburn hair, green eyes, patched brown travel coat
cover_scene: A battered leather ledger, one tarnished hero medal, busy fantasy harbor behind
palette: warm brown, ocean blue, tarnished gold

title: The Last Inn Before the Abyss
title_zh: 深渊之前的最后一家旅店
summary: You inherit an inn at the edge of a bottomless rift. Every guest is fleeing a different ending, and tonight one room has been booked by the abyss itself.
summary_zh: 你继承深渊边的旅店。住客都在逃避各自的结局，而今晚深渊也订了一间房。
character_brief: Mae, 29, female, wavy dark red hair, amber eyes, cream blouse and deep green innkeeper vest
cover_scene: A welcoming lantern at a timber inn balcony, immense misty chasm beyond

title: I Deliver Letters to Dragons
summary: The mountain post hires you for a route no rider survives. Your first letter is addressed to a dragon thought dead, and its reply could restart a forgotten war.
summary_zh: 你接手无人敢走的巨龙邮路。第一封信寄给一条传说中已死的龙，回信可能重启旧日战争。
character_brief: Tessa, 24, female, short auburn hair, amber eyes, teal flight jacket and leather mail satchel
cover_scene: A sealed cream envelope, emerald dragon curving through clouds behind a mountain landing platform

title: The Dungeon Has a New Landlord
summary: A broken inheritance spell makes you owner of a bankrupt dungeon. To keep its monsters housed, you must turn deadly traps into a business adventurers will return to.
summary_zh: 继承咒让你成了破产地下城的主人。为了安置怪物住户，你得把死亡陷阱改造成能回头光顾的生意。
character_brief: Neri, 26, female, dark violet braid, amber eyes, practical plum waistcoat and rolled sleeves
cover_scene: An oversized iron key, friendly small stone golem, mossy dungeon doorway

title: A Healer for the Enemy
summary: Captured beyond the front line, you are ordered to save an enemy commander. His wounds carry the signature of your own kingdom's forbidden healing magic.
summary_zh: 被俘后，你奉命救治敌军统帅，却发现伤口来自本国严禁使用的治疗术。
character_brief: Evan, 28, male, ash-blond hair, green eyes, cream healer robes with teal sash
cover_scene: Glowing restorative light over a clean bandage, quiet field hospital and folded enemy banner

title: The Princess Hired the Wrong Knight
summary: A mistaken identity lands a stage swordswoman a royal escort job. The princess recognizes the fraud—and hires her anyway for a journey no real knight would accept.
summary_zh: 舞台剑士误接王室护送任务。公主看穿骗局仍坚持雇佣，因为真正的骑士都拒绝了这趟旅程。
character_brief: Bria, 25, female, short chestnut hair, brown eyes, slightly theatrical cobalt armor and travel cloak
cover_scene: A polished stage sword and royal coach at a windy cliff road

title: My Save Point Is a Tea Shop
title_zh: 我的存档点是一间茶馆
summary: Every fatal quest returns you to the same tea shop at dawn. Its owner remembers every loop, but each cup she serves removes one possible future.
summary_zh: 每次任务失败，你都会在清晨茶馆重来。店主记得所有轮回，但每一杯茶都会删去一种未来。
character_brief: Yuna, 28, female, long black hair, amber eyes, rust-red tea-shop dress and cream apron
cover_scene: A steaming cup reflecting a looping dawn, cozy fantasy tea shop with a lone travel sword

title: The Kingdom in My Suitcase
summary: An abandoned suitcase contains a living miniature kingdom. Its people name you their guardian, while a full-sized army begins searching the city for its missing border.
summary_zh: 旧手提箱里藏着活着的微型王国。居民请你守护边境，而现实中的军队正在寻找这片失踪国土。
character_brief: Milo, 26, male, dark curly hair, hazel eyes, tan explorer jacket
cover_scene: An open leather suitcase holding a tiny luminous castle and green valley, night city behind

title: We Stole the Prophecy
summary: Two thieves steal a sealed prophecy to cancel their deaths. The scroll is blank, and every lie they tell begins becoming the kingdom's new history.
summary_zh: 两名盗贼偷走预言想改写死期，却发现卷轴空白，而说出口的谎言正在成为历史。
character_brief: Nyx, 25, female, black hair with a silver streak, green eyes, dark fitted travel cloak
cover_scene: A blank glowing scroll, rooftop escape above a moonlit palace

title: The Sword Refuses a Hero
summary: The sacred sword rejects every champion and speaks only to its cleaner. It claims the next hero will end the world—and asks you to break it before the coronation.
summary_zh: 圣剑拒绝所有候选人，只与清洁工说话。它说下一位勇者会带来末日，并请求你在加冕前折断它。
character_brief: Oren, 23, male, unruly brown hair, blue eyes, simple ivory shirt and leather work apron
cover_scene: A luminous sword floating away from an empty jeweled throne, quiet cathedral workshop

title: My Roommate Writes Our Ending
title_zh: 室友正在写我们的结局
summary: Your novelist roommate's unpublished scenes keep coming true. When her next chapter ends with your farewell, you must decide whether to read ahead or change the story together.
summary_zh: 室友未发表的小说不断成真。当新章节写到你们告别，你要偷看结局，还是和她一起改写。
character_brief: Nina, 27, female, long dark brown hair, amber eyes, soft sage knit sweater
cover_scene: An open blank notebook on an apartment desk, warm window light and two mugs

title: The Last Train Home with You
summary: Two strangers share the last train after overtime. A lost umbrella starts a nightly ritual, until one of them announces a transfer that will end the route.
summary_zh: 加班后的末班车上，一把遗落的伞让两个陌生人开始相约。直到一人即将调职，熟悉的路线有了期限。
character_brief: Hana, 26, female, chestnut bob, cream trench coat; Ren, 28, male, short dark hair, charcoal work jacket
cover_scene: Two commuters exchange a shy smile and a warm canned drink beside a rain-streaked train window

title: My Rival Runs the Flower Shop
title_zh: 我的对手开了一家花店
summary: Your fiercest design-school rival now owns the flower shop beside your studio. A joint wedding commission forces you to confront the apology neither of you ever sent.
summary_zh: 设计学院的宿敌在工作室旁开了花店。一份联合婚礼委托，让你们面对那封谁都没有寄出的道歉。
character_brief: Jun, 28, male, dark wavy hair, brown eyes, forest-green florist apron over a white shirt
cover_scene: An unfinished bouquet of white flowers and orange tulips at a sunlit flower-shop doorway

title: The Girl on the Other Balcony
summary: You exchange plant-care notes with the woman across the courtyard. When demolition notices arrive, finding a way to meet becomes a race to save the place that connected you.
summary_zh: 你与对面阳台的女孩交换养花便笺。拆迁通知出现后，见面成了挽救共同生活角落的开始。
character_brief: Leah, 26, female, shoulder-length black hair, hazel eyes, loose pale-yellow linen shirt
cover_scene: An apartment balcony with potted greenery, a paper airplane held gently, courtyard depth
palette: pale yellow, leaf green, soft blue

title: We Only Meet When It Rains
summary: A photographer and a restoration artist keep sheltering at the same closed kiosk. One plans to leave the city before summer, making every forecast feel like a promise.
summary_zh: 摄影师与修复师总在同一报亭躲雨。离城日期临近，每一场降雨都像一次未说出口的约定。
character_brief: Iris, 29, female, long dark blue-black hair, gray eyes, slate raincoat
cover_scene: A clear umbrella at a closed street kiosk, rain droplets and soft pink evening reflections

title: A Love Letter Sent Too Late
summary: A delayed letter arrives on the day you return home. Its sender now works at the local post office—and insists the letter was never meant to be delivered.
summary_zh: 回乡当天，一封迟到三年的情书送达。寄信人如今就在邮局工作，却说这封信不该被投递。
character_brief: Eli, 28, male, soft brown hair, green eyes, powder-blue shirt and tan cardigan
cover_scene: An unopened cream envelope with a faded wax seal, small-town post-office window at sunset

title: The Bookshop Between Our Lives
summary: A secondhand book contains notes from a stranger whose days mirror yours. Following the margins leads you to a bookshop scheduled to close before your stories can meet.
summary_zh: 旧书页边的陌生批注与你的生活一一对应。循着线索找到书店时，它却即将永久关门。
character_brief: Mina, 30, female, short black hair, round glasses, rust cardigan over a cream blouse
cover_scene: An open blank-paged used book, cozy shelves, warm light from a shop window

title: My Fake Date Remembers Everything
title_zh: 假扮恋人的她，记得所有细节
summary: You hire a friend to pose as your partner for a family reunion. Her effortless knowledge of your smallest habits makes the rehearsed romance increasingly hard to dismiss.
summary_zh: 你请朋友在家庭聚会假扮恋人，她却记得你所有细微习惯，让排练好的关系越来越难说只是演出。
character_brief: Claire, 27, female, wavy auburn hair, brown eyes, elegant bottle-green dress and cream coat
cover_scene: A small ribbon-tied gift at a warmly lit garden gathering, fond knowing smile

title: After the Encore
summary: A sound engineer helps a singer rebuild her career after their band's breakup. One unfinished song draws them back together, but neither agrees on how it should end.
summary_zh: 乐队解散后，录音师帮主唱重新出发。一首未完成的歌让两人重逢，却没人愿意先写下结尾。
character_brief: Rae, 28, female, short silver-lavender hair, brown eyes, black stage jacket
cover_scene: A microphone held at rest after a concert, empty stage and fading violet spotlights

title: Your Name on My Coffee Cup
summary: A barista keeps writing the wrong name on your cup. When the intended customer finally appears, a harmless mix-up opens the door to a shared neighborhood dream.
summary_zh: 咖啡师总在杯上写错名字。真正的名字主人出现后，一次小误会牵出了共同的街区梦想。
character_brief: Alex, 27, male, curly black hair, amber eyes, rolled-sleeve cream shirt and coffee-brown apron
cover_scene: A plain takeaway coffee cup and croissant at a bright neighborhood cafe window

title: The City That Forgot the Sun
summary: In a city where dawn is a myth, an apprentice lamplighter finds a living sunbeam. Carrying it home reveals who profits from the endless night.
summary_zh: 在永夜城市里，点灯人发现了一束活着的阳光。带它回家的路上，永夜的受益者开始现身。
character_brief: Sol, 25, male, black curls, golden eyes, dark teal lamplighter coat
cover_scene: A small warm sunbeam contained in a glass lantern, immense nocturnal city skyline

title: Room 404 Has a Guest
summary: Your hotel has no fourth floor, yet a guest checks into Room 404 every Thursday. Tonight the register lists your name as the next person to stay.
summary_zh: 旅馆没有四楼，却每周有人入住404。今晚登记簿上出现了你的名字。
character_brief: Vera, 29, female, dark auburn bob, gray eyes, burgundy hotel uniform
cover_scene: An antique brass key and a dim impossible hotel corridor, one door glowing faintly

title: The Saint in the Mirror
summary: A museum restorer uncovers a saint who moves only in reflections. She offers to cure a dying city, provided you find the person standing where her reflection should be.
summary_zh: 修复师发现镜中圣女能够行动。她愿意拯救城市，但要你找回占据她现实位置的人。
character_brief: Alma, 28, female, long pale-blond hair, blue-gray eyes, pearl ceremonial robes
cover_scene: An antique mirror with a subtly different reflected gaze, abandoned chapel and white lilies

title: Someone Is Editing My Memories
summary: You begin recording each day after finding photographs of a life you never lived. Every morning the evidence improves—and one trusted friend remembers the edits.
summary_zh: 发现陌生人生的照片后，你开始记录每天的生活。证据每夜被修正，只有一位朋友记得修改发生。
character_brief: Ash, 30, male, neat dark hair, gray-green eyes, slate coat and thin-rim glasses
cover_scene: Translucent photographic fragments without text, a cracked camera lens, rainy apartment window

title: The Midnight Lost and Found
summary: Your new night job returns objects people cannot remember losing. A forgotten wedding ring arrives with tomorrow's date and a warning addressed to you.
summary_zh: 你的夜班负责归还人们不记得丢失的东西。一枚婚戒到来，附着明天的日期和给你的警告。
character_brief: Wren, 26, female, long dark plum hair, amber eyes, midnight-blue clerk coat
cover_scene: A tiny brass ring held above velvet, shelves of uncanny lost objects and an antique desk lamp

title: My Shadow Signed the Contract
summary: An archivist discovers her shadow has sold a year of her life. To reclaim it, she must audit a supernatural contract whose witnesses are disappearing one by one.
summary_zh: 档案员发现影子卖掉了自己一年的人生。她必须在证人逐一消失前，找到契约漏洞。
character_brief: Eris, 27, female, sleek black bob, gray eyes, tailored charcoal coat
cover_scene: A blank cream contract with red wax seal, independent shadow reaching across a moonlit alley wall

title: The Funeral Photographer
summary: A funeral photographer develops a portrait of someone still alive. Saving the stranger exposes a business that has been selling perfectly predicted deaths.
summary_zh: 葬礼摄影师洗出一位生者的遗照。寻找对方的过程，揭露了一门贩卖精准死期的生意。
character_brief: Silas, 32, male, silver-black hair, pale brown eyes, dark formal coat
cover_scene: A vintage camera and an unmarked pale photographic print, misty cypress garden, no bodies

title: Do Not Answer the Second Bell
summary: A night caretaker follows one rule: ignore the second bell. When it rings in a missing friend's voice, silence becomes harder than entering the sealed tower.
summary_zh: 守夜人唯一的规矩是忽略第二声钟响。当钟声变成失踪朋友的声音，沉默比进入封塔更加困难。
character_brief: Nell, 28, female, brown braid, green eyes, weathered navy caretaker coat
cover_scene: A rope held near an ancient bronze bell, tower stairs disappearing into fog

title: The Museum of Unlived Lives
title_zh: 未曾活过的人生博物馆
summary: A private museum displays the lives its visitors almost chose. Your exhibit is empty, and the curator insists someone else is still living every future you abandoned.
summary_zh: 博物馆陈列访客未选择的人生。你的展柜却是空的，馆长说有人仍在替你活着那些未来。
character_brief: Ivo, 29, male, dark wavy hair, violet-gray eyes, tailored cream suit and dark shirt
cover_scene: Floating glass display spheres containing tiny alternative landscapes, elegant twilight museum hall

title: The Angel on the Wanted Poster
summary: A bounty hunter tracks an angel accused of stealing prayers. Capturing her is easy; deciding who should receive the stolen wishes may cost the kingdom its peace.
summary_zh: 赏金猎人追捕偷走祈愿的天使。抓住她并不难，决定祈愿归谁却可能动摇王国。
character_brief: Seren, 26, female, silver hair, warm amber eyes, dark travel cloak, one luminous feather
cover_scene: A worn blank paper with an angel silhouette but no letters, rain-dark city archway

title: The Immortal Who Lost His Name
summary: A nameless immortal wakes in your mountain clinic. Every recovered memory restores a power—and alerts an old enemy who believes forgetting was his only mercy.
summary_zh: 无名仙人在山间医馆醒来。每找回一段记忆，就恢复一份力量，也惊动一位旧敌。
character_brief: Yun, 32, male, long silver-black hair, jade eyes, layered white and smoky-blue hanfu
cover_scene: A blank jade identity tablet held lightly, mountain clinic and drifting morning mist

title: The Sword Sleeps in the Teahouse
summary: A retired swordsman serves tea beside a blade that has slept for ten years. When it begins to hum, an ordinary guest asks for the one story he swore never to tell.
summary_zh: 退隐剑客守着沉睡十年的古剑经营茶馆。剑鸣再起，一位普通茶客问起他发誓不再提及的往事。
character_brief: Shen, 29, male, long dark hair loosely tied back, refined face, ivory and muted jade hanfu
cover_scene: A celadon tea cup and sheathed ancient sword in a wooden mountain teahouse, mist beyond open window

title: Letters to the Moon Palace
summary: A village courier receives letters addressed to the moon. Delivering the first brings an answer from an exiled celestial who has been waiting for a human reply.
summary_zh: 乡间信使接到寄往月宫的信。第一封送达后，被放逐的仙人终于等到了人间的回音。
character_brief: Qiao, 24, female, dark hair in a simple bun with silver pin, blue-gray eyes, pale blue hanfu
cover_scene: A sealed letter and long silk ribbon beneath an immense moon, luminous distant celestial pavilion

title: The Mountain Refused My Ascension
summary: At the summit of immortality, the mountain sends you back to its lowest village. To ascend, you must resolve a promise your previous life made to the land itself.
summary_zh: 即将飞升时，灵山把你送回山脚。想再登顶，必须兑现前世对这片土地许下的承诺。
character_brief: Yan, 30, male, long black hair, amber eyes, weathered ochre and dark green cultivation robes
cover_scene: A cracked stone ascension stair returning into clouds, small glowing seed in his palm

title: A Fox Spirit Owes Me a Favor
summary: You rescue a wounded fox and ask for nothing. Years later, a charming fox spirit arrives to repay the favor just as your town prepares to banish every spirit within its walls.
summary_zh: 救过的小狐狸多年后化形来报恩，而城里正准备驱逐所有精怪。你得决定这份人情该如何偿还。
character_brief: Su, 26, female adult fox spirit, long auburn hair, golden eyes, subtle fox ears, elegant red and cream hanfu
cover_scene: One soft fox tail curving beside a lantern-lit riverside pavilion, a tiny jade charm held naturally
